briefdescription.para: Add an index definition to a list, preserving the first position of the primary key.

detaileddescription.para: In non-unique indexes, secondary keys must contain key parts of the primary key. This is necessary to make ordered retrieval from a secondary key useful to SQL optimizer and make iterators over secondary keys stable in presence of concurrent updates. Thus we always create the primary key first, and put the primary key key_def first in the index_def list.
